When true, /amnesia (agent.py) or the webagent Amnesia button immediately re-feeds the compressed recap back into history ('rebirth') as soon as it wipes memory. When false, /amnesia wipes to a true blank slate and the recap waits on disk until /rebirth is run manually.

Master switch for the sub-agent system (lib_bejson_newagent_subagent_*.py). When false (the default -- new/experimental feature), dispatch_subagent()/run_subagent_turn()/resume_subagent() all refuse immediately with status='disabled' and create/mutate nothing on disk; existing subagent session/signal/profile files are left untouched either way. Flip to true to allow the main agent (or any tool built on top of it) to actually dispatch sub-agent sessions.

Master switch (true/false) for the Antigravity (agy) skills compatibility layer (lib_bejson_newagent_agy_skills.py). When false (the default), agy skills are completely disabled with zero context or action overhead. Flip to true to discover SKILL.md bundles and enable <agy_skill> / /skills as an alternative to the tool system.
